title: Continue your ChatGPT experience beyond WhatsApp
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: ChatGPT will no longer be available on WhatsApp after January 15, 2026. Learn how to link your ChatGPT account and continue your conversations across devices....
body:
ChatGPT will no longer be available on WhatsApp after January 15, 2026. Learn how to link your ChatGPT account and continue your conversations across devices.
